title: The Great Blockade
reviewNotes: Three branches from seven pieces after Kc8 at 54s. Full selected Be8/c5/Bxd7 route restricts h- and c-pawns, collects c4, checks with Be6 and blocks with Bh3 to release Ka8. Alternative d5 allows a checking bishop offer and promotion. Separate final king-retreat comparison is independent. The Bh3 node is legally derived; its timestamp points to source samples spanning the subsequent king moves. Corrected spoken king-to-e8 to visually shown Be8. Earlier eight-piece sacrifice remains context.
